kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننفلت (form VII)
# نَنْفَلِتُ (nanfalitu) /nan.fa.li.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# نَنْفَلِتَ (nanfalita) /nan.fa.li.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# نَنْفَلِتْ (nanfalit) /nan.fa.lit/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
